entries.profile_scope: 7B v6 target-bound synthetic long-file model screen, seeds 101/202/303
entries.expected_invariant: A candidate for a source that refers to one door must not silently change the referent to multiple doors, even if the JSON slot and identifier are valid.
entries.last_outcome: The 7B model pluralized the singular door on all 12 archived pairs; 1.8B kept singular on the same cues/seeds; model selection and human review remain open.
